info.title: Simplicity-First .NET Toolkit CLI
info.description: Global CLI entry point for the Simplicity-First .NET Toolkit.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a solution and print a snapshot summary of its simplicity metrics.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: 'text' (default) or 'json'. JSON goes to stdout with nothing else, for CI consumption.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print full exception details when the command fails.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes:
0  Success.
1  Error (bad arguments, analysis failure) or regression with --fail-on-regression.
Files (all created/read next to the solution file):
simplicity.json            Optional thresholds/TCA configuration; defaults apply when absent.
.simplicity-baseline.json  Baseline snapshot written by 'baseline', read by 'diff'.
.simplicity-history/       Snapshot history appended by 'report' and 'baseline'.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare the current snapshot against the saved baseline and list regressions.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: 'text' (default) or 'json'. JSON goes to stdout with nothing else, for CI consumption.

options.name: --fail-on-regression
options.description: Exit with code 1 when the diff detects one or more regressions.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print full exception details when the command fails.
